title: Cosmic Ruins Airship
description: A surreal scene inside a decaying, elongated chamber with crumbling walls covered in circular portals revealing galaxies and nebulae. A large ornate hot air balloon with intricate red, blue and gold patterns floats near the ceiling while several metallic UFOs fly through the space, one emitting purple smoke from its base.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene inside a long decaying industrial corridor with crumbling walls full of circular portals showing galaxies and colorful nebulae. An ornate vintage hot air balloon with intricate red blue and gold patterns floats near the ceiling with tattered banners hanging below it. Several metallic flying saucers and UFOs navigate the space, one trailing thick purple smoke from its engines. Dark moody atmosphere with glowing portal lights and dripping textures.
